_readme: Free-text fields for the organiser-style pack (tools/organiser_pack.py).
Drafted 2026-09-23 by two glm-5.3-flash subagents from each case's claim text and intake
answers only, then reviewed by the planner: three descriptions corrected for added or wrong facts
(RD-0102 'in the app', NS-0206 'no-show' -> 'cancellation', OS-0301 'cleaning up'), one
duplicate name and two confusable plates replaced. Names and plates are fictional.
The generator refuses any description that introduces a number its source never states.

NS-0201.description: I was charged a no-show fee but I was still on my way down. I was in the lift, about 2 minutes away, when the driver messaged that he had arrived. Being charged for a no-show when I was coming down to the lobby is completely unfair. I want this charge reversed immediately.

NS-0202.description: The driver cancelled almost immediately and I was still charged. He sent one message saying he arrived, then cancelled about a minute after — and I was walking out of the building and could see the car. How is that a no-show on my part? I want this charge taken off.

NS-0203.description: The driver never came to the pickup point but I was charged a no-show fee. He said he arrived, but he was never outside my block, and I was standing at the pickup point the whole time. There were no calls, just the arrival notification. This charge is completely unfair and I want it reversed.

NS-0204.description: I waited 20 minutes at the pickup point from the start and the driver never moved towards me. He never responded to any of my messages either. I had to cancel it myself because he simply never arrived, and now I'm being charged for it. Please reverse this unfair charge.

NS-0205.description: The driver says I did not show up, but I say he was not there. I was at the taxi stand as booked and the driver was not. He messaged that he was waiting, but I did not see him anywhere. I want this no-show charge reversed.

NS-0206.description: I cancelled within two minutes of booking because my plans changed, and I was still charged. I was at home and the driver had not even started coming, and he never contacted me at all. Being charged a cancellation fee for that is completely unfair. I want the charge removed.

NS-0207.description: I was charged a waiting fee even though the trip went ahead. The driver messaged when he arrived, and I came down about 6 minutes after that, yet there is an extra charge on my receipt for waiting time. The trip happened, so the waiting fee makes no sense to me. I want the extra charge removed.

OS-0301.description: My passenger was sick in the back seat and left a real mess in my car at the drop-off point. Because of it I lost the rest of my shift. This shouldn't come out of my pocket, so I want the cleaning fee paid.

RD-0101.description: The driver completely ignored the route the app showed and drove a long way round instead. The app had shown about 6.4 km via the expressway, but he took a much longer way and I ended up paying more than the quoted fare. I never agreed to any different route and I didn't ask him to stop anywhere. I want a refund of the extra I was charged.

RD-0102.description: My final fare came out higher than what the app quoted when I booked. To be upfront, I did ask the driver to drop my colleague first and I added a stop, so the route wasn't the direct route to my original drop-off — but the fare was still more than the quote and that doesn't feel right. I want the difference refunded.

RD-0103.description: The driver didn't take the exact route the app displayed when I booked. I never agreed to any change and I didn't ask him to stop anywhere either. It might sound small, but the app is supposed to show you the route you're getting and he just went his own way. I want this reviewed and the fare corrected.

RD-0104.description: This was a long trip to the airport and the driver left the expressway and went a long way round instead of taking the direct expressway route the app showed. It cost me more than it should have. I never agreed to a detour and I didn't ask him to stop. I want the extra cost refunded.

RD-0105.description: The driver drove much further than the route the app showed — it should have been about 7 km direct. Instead he took a longer route and I paid for distance I never should have travelled. I never agreed to a different route and I didn't ask him to stop. I want the extra distance refunded.

RD-0106.description: This isn't actually about the route — the route was agreed and fine. The problem is the bill: my receipt total is more than the items listed on it add up to, and I was charged more than the parts listed. A receipt that doesn't match its own line items is just not acceptable. I want the bill corrected and the difference refunded.

RD-0107.description: The trip took nearly twice as long as the app estimated and it cost me more. I had agreed to the route and the app said it should have taken about 22 minutes, but it dragged on far longer than that. I didn't ask the driver to stop anywhere. I want the extra fare refunded.

RD-0108.description: I think the driver went a long way round — the whole trip just felt much longer than it should have been. Honestly, I don't remember exactly what the app showed for the route, so I can't compare it directly, but something felt off. I never agreed to any different route and I didn't ask him to stop. I'd like the trip reviewed and the fare looked at.

RD-0109.description: The driver went a very long way round on what was already an expensive surge-priced trip — he drove nearly twice the distance. The direct route should have been about 31 km, but this felt endless and the fare stung even before the detour. I never agreed to a different route and I didn't ask him to stop. I want the extra distance refunded.
